relationships.subject: arthroscopic meniscal repair
relationships.evidence_quote: BK concentrations showed the greatest differential response

key_findings: Serum PGE2, bradykinin and 5-HT were significantly lower 6 months after meniscal repair than after partial meniscectomy.
Repair also gave better Oxford/Lysholm scores, gait and MRI outcomes.
